question: How often is the World Happiness Report released?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Annually**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The World Happiness Report is released **once every year**, making it an annual publication.
 
• The report is published by the **Sustainable Development Solutions Network (SDSN)** in partnership with other organizations.
 
• It evaluates happiness levels in countries based on factors like **social support, income, health, freedom, generosity, and trust.**
 
• The first World Happiness Report was released in **2012**, and it has continued annually since then.
 
• The report uses data from the **Gallup World Poll** and other official statistics to calculate the happiness rankings.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Key Components of the Report:** The report examines subjective well-being through three main measures: life evaluations, positive emotions, and negative emotions.
 
• **Country Rankings:** The rankings are based on a three-year rolling average of survey results, ensuring reliability and reducing anomalies.
 
• **Six Key Variables:** The six factors used for rankings include GDP per capita, social support, healthy life expectancy, freedom, generosity, and corruption perception.
 
• **Purpose:** The report aims to influence global policies by highlighting the importance of happiness as a measure of societal progress.
 
• **Global Impact:** The World Happiness Report is widely cited and has become a key resource for understanding the social and economic well-being of countries.
